known_facts: The Mindbloom Petal is the only known cure for 'mind-fracturing' curses.
Legend says the petal can 'restore what was taken' from a mind.
The petal is connected to the Blue Moon and is said to bloom in the Whispering Caves.
I do not know the specific harvesting technique, only that it is fragile.
The village Herbalist is the local expert on rare plants and likely knows the harvesting secret.
I have read every account of mind-fracturing I could find; there are eleven, and nine of them are worthless.
The Blue Moon returns in nineteen years, and I do not believe Lian has nineteen quiet years left in him.
I have mapped the Whispering Caves from three separate travellers' accounts, and no two of the maps agree.
My research fills four journals, and only the fourth one matters.
I tried to enter the caves alone once, and I turned back before the first bend.
Silas laughed when I asked him to source obsidian for me; he told me myths do not sell.
Lian and I were born moments apart, and something passed between us that night that should not have.
